name: crt0_start
comment: Reset entry (jr from vector 0). Sets gp=0xFFFF0000, tp=0x0001A238, sp=0xFFFFEFFC; zeroes .bss; calls the module init chain (CAN init, COM, PLA, ...). source: re-trace.

name: can_com_init
comment: CAN + COM init (called from crt0). Brings up AFCAN ch1 @500kbps and ch2 @1Mbps via afcan_init_channel, then registers RX PDUs and the PLA/park-assist + supervision layers. source: re-trace.

name: afcan_cfg_buffer
comment: AFCAN driver: configure a message-buffer's control/config regs (0xFFFFFD00 + (buf-1)*0x20) and its acceptance mask (0xfffff1d6/d8). param1=buffer#, param2=cfg flags. source: re-trace.

name: afcan_init_channel
comment: AFCAN driver: set up one CAN channel (bitrate/clock) and its buffers. Calls afcan_cfg_buffer + FUN_00010040/000100c0. Called twice by can_com_init: ch1 500000bps, ch2 1000000bps. source: re-trace.

name: com_pdu_register
comment: COM: register one RX PDU into the router. args(pdu_struct, channel, rx_buffer, e2e_data_id, start_bit, size_bits). Stores id@+0xc, startbit@+0xe; flags oversize (>0x7ff bits) invalid. 21 PDUs registered by com_register_rx_pdus. source: re-trace.

name: com_pdu_check_fresh
comment: COM: check whether a registered RX PDU has fresh data (compares stored E2E checksum via e2e_crc). Returns 0 when stale. source: re-trace.

name: com_pdu_unpack
comment: COM: unpack a fresh RX PDU from the router byte-stream into its buffer, validating the E2E checksum (e2e_crc). source: re-trace.

name: e2e_crc
comment: COM E2E checksum compute (compared against the frame's CHECKSUM byte on RX). source: re-trace.

name: com_register_rx_pdus
comment: COM: registers all 21 RX PDUs (16 distinct msgs, several as redundant twins / on both buses) via com_pdu_register into router 0xfffece9c. Buffers 0xfffe8038..0xfffe9190. source: re-trace.

name: com_process_rx_pdus
comment: COM: per-cycle RX processing; fans out to the per-message consumers (com_rx_msg_*), each doing freshness+E2E then unpack. source: re-trace.

name: msg_supervision_set
comment: COM: report per-message reception status to the supervision/DTC layer. arg2 = message-group tag (0x02/04/08/20/40/80/100/200). source: re-trace.

name: com_rx_msg_g80
comment: RX consumer for the redundant PDU pair -> supervision tag 0x80; picks whichever twin is fresh, unpacks, reports. source: re-trace.

name: com_rx_msg_g20

name: com_rx_msg_g40

name: com_rx_msg_g100

name: com_rx_msg_g02

name: com_rx_msg_g200

name: com_rx_msg_g04

name: com_rx_msg_g08

name: steer_ctrl_statemachine
comment: CANDIDATE: large (987-line) steering-control state machine (sole caller FUN_0002e52c); reads the cal parameter block iRamfffe9ef4 and mode flags cRamfffee195/198; uses both 9-bit (0x1ff) and 13-bit (0x1fff) request fields. Likely the HCA/PLA request arbitration+limiting. NOT yet fully traced. source: re-trace(partial).

name: ctrl_signal_proc
comment: CANDIDATE: control/signal computation reading cal block iRamfffe9ef4; symmetric clamp to +/-0x8e4. Role (which actuator quantity) not yet confirmed. source: re-trace(partial).

name: ctrl_task
comment: Steering-control task: runs the control cycle (ctrl_cycle) and writes steer signal block outputs. source: re-trace.

name: ctrl_cycle
comment: Main control cycle: ordered pipeline of ~25 stages (y*_step control modules); calls steer_ctrl_apply in the middle. source: re-trace.

name: steer_ctrl_apply
comment: Steer-control wrapper: gathers ~13 inputs from the steer signal block (0xfffec56x/58x) into the SM working area, runs steer_ctrl_statemachine (gated by uRamfffee3ec bit0x40000), distributes outputs to 0xfffec55e/560/562/5c2. source: re-trace.

name: steer_ctrl_out
comment: Post-control output stage: writes SM working results (uRamfffee1ae/1b0/1ba) back to steer signal block outputs (0xfffec562/5c2/560) + status. source: re-trace.

name: steer_sigblock_init
comment: Zero-init of the steering-control signal block 0xfffec550..0xfffec5cc (defaults: +0x31=1,+0x32=0xf,+0x45/46=3). Called once from can_com_init. source: re-trace.

name: steer_sigblock
comment: Steering-control signal block base (0xfffec550..0xfffec5cc): the central arbitrated-signal struct read by steer_ctrl_apply. Fields 0x56x/0x58x = control-SM inputs; 0x55e/560/562/5c2 = outputs. source: re-trace.

name: ctrl_cal_block_ptr
comment: Pointer to the control cal-parameter block (RAM shadow of flash cal) indexed by steer_ctrl_statemachine and ctrl_signal_proc as *(iRamfffe9ef4 + off). source: re-trace.

name: tp_send
comment: ISO-TP transport send/segment (via tp connection state 0xfffec638). Confirms the 0xfffece9c 'router' is the TP/diagnostic path, NOT the periodic-signal COM. source: re-trace.

name: assist_trq_deviation_monitor
comment: Internal assist torque-tracking safety monitor on eps_assist_status(0xfffed784): expected=request*speed_gain; |measured-expected| > speed-proportional tol (+0xf8, escalate +0x5ed) for ~70 cycles -> latch dev-fault(+0x52) + cut. source: re-trace.

name: assist_get_status
comment: Return the assist-module status field *(state+0x10) (e.g. uRamfffecaac; value 5 gates ctrl_task). source: re-trace.

name: eps_assist_status
comment: EPS INTERNAL assist/monitor status struct (NOT the received HCA command). +0x10=assist status (assist_get_status), +0x14=internal escalation level set by FUN_000177aa from motor-speed thresholds 0x6323/0x6f86. Corrected via subagent trace. source: re-trace.

name: eps_assist_status_copy
comment: Copy of eps_assist_status+0x10; ==5 checked in ctrl_task (internal state, not received HCA). source: re-trace.

name: can_service
comment: Per-cycle CAN service (from ctrl_task), 2 channels: RX loop = if can_rx_fifo_ready, can_rx_fifo_read into rxbuf then can_rx_frame_reassemble; TX loop = can_tx_fifo_flush then can_tx_fifo_write per queued frame. Gated by iRamfffe9ef8 state (2->3). source: re-trace.

name: can_service_init
comment: CAN service init (from can_com_init): stores the 2 channel handles (uRamfffec62c/630), clears rxbuf/counters, brings up both channels (FUN_000105b0/FUN_000160aa). source: re-trace.

name: can_rx_fifo_read
comment: CAN RX: drain the receive FIFO (reg 0xfffffd42, count = low nibble of 0xfffffd48/d88) into a memory buffer, per channel (param+0xc = 0 -> ch1 fd4x, 1 -> ch2 fd8x). source: re-trace.

name: can_rx_fifo_ready
comment: CAN RX: test whether the receive FIFO holds a complete frame (returns 0 when data available). source: re-trace.

name: can_rx_frame_reassemble
comment: CAN RX frame processor: parse the FIFO frame header (counter bits 0x30, type bits 0xc0), check sequence continuity vs expected counter (byte at 0xfffec5e4+ch), reassemble payload into the per-channel rx buffer, flag gaps/overrun in the status word. source: re-trace.

name: can_tx_fifo_write
comment: CAN TX: write a frame word (param2) to the transmit FIFO/mask regs (0xfffffd44/d46 ch1, d84/d86 ch2) if the buffer is free (0xfffffd48 bit0x40==0). source: re-trace.

name: can_tx_fifo_flush
comment: CAN TX: drain/flush the transmit FIFO for a channel (reads 0xfffffd42 count times; sets 0xfffffd48 bit0x80). source: re-trace.

name: can_tx_msgbuf_load
comment: CAN TX: load a transmit message buffer's ID+8 data bytes (0xfffffd40/d80 buffer, data regs d50-d5e/d90-d96). (was afcan_tx_msgbuf). source: re-trace.

name: periph_hw_init
comment: Peripheral hardware init (from the crt0 init chain): ports 0xfffff600.., timers/PWM, and the CAN receive buffers (0xfffffd40/d80: config=7, mask=0xffff, id=0, data preset 2). source: re-trace.

name: afcan_set_bittiming

name: motor_pwm_gate_ctrl

name: motor_pwm_enable

name: motor_pwm_phaseU

name: ctrl_worker_main_torque
comment: CANDIDATE: largest control-cycle worker (926L, 46 cal-block params, wrapped by ctrl_cyc_st05) -- the core steering-torque computation with heavy saturation arithmetic; reads _ctrl_cal_block_ptr maps, writes the 0xfffee2xx working torque area. Exact sub-function (assist boost vs damping vs compensator) needs the A2L. source: re-trace(partial). HCA-status handling: {5,7}=full engage (identical), 6=limited, 3=off; active max-torque cal=+0x306 (vs +0x2a2 idle), speed clamp +0x2fe/+0x304. source: re-trace+subagent."

name: ctrl_worker_d
comment: MONITOR/plausibility worker (485L, wrapped by ctrl_cyc_st16), NOT actuation. Applies a mode-indexed gain that differs for HCA status 5 vs 7 (0003857e.c:182-210): gain=*(cal+0x10) if mode==7, *(cal+0xe) if mode==5, else 0xffff; out=torque_sum*gain>>16 -> hca_mode_gained_torque(0xfffee12a). VERIFIED: its outputs feed ONLY the inverse-redundancy safety RAM (0002e06e), plausibility comparators (000374ae->ctrl_task), and diagnostic/UDS/CAN-TX telemetry -- it writes NONE of the motor-command sigblock outputs (fffec55e/560/562/5c2). So 5 vs 7 does NOT change delivered torque (that path is sm_out*0x4b, fixed; FUN_00034d78 + steer_ctrl_statemachine group 5/7). The 5/7 gain can only shift monitor/fault-plausibility behavior. Mode from assist_mode_echo_a/b. source: re-trace+subagent(verified).

name: boot_tick_counter

Gates ALL received-message supervision: while below the grace threshold, supervision is suppressed and EPS reports the benign default (EPS_HCA_Status=READY=3); once above, supervision runs and an absent HCA_01 resolves to FAULT=2. source: re-trace(subagent).

name: supervision_grace_cal

Guards `boot_tick_counter <= supervision_grace_cal` across ~7 supervision fns. ~10430 ticks =~1043ms (empirically matched); hard literal cap 0x2f15=12053 ticks=~1205ms. Read live for exact value. source: re-trace(subagent).

name: supervision_status_init

name: hca_mode5_monitor_gain

Mode-7 counterpart to hca_mode5_monitor_gain; affects only the plausibility/monitor plane, not delivered torque (which is 5==7). source: re-trace+subagent(verified).

Consumed only by the inverse-redundancy safety RAM (lockstep ~copy in 0002e06e.c: fffee31a/446) and plausibility/telemetry -- NOT the motor drive. Not delivered torque. source: re-trace(verified).

name: hca_engage_time_counter

Tick EMPIRICALLY confirmed: route 15e6fc3f...00000144 forced 10 timeouts spaced 364.7s +-0.34, engaged windows ~362.8s, EPS_HCA_Status 7->4(held ~2.04s)->3 handover. Threshold is static flash, NOT coding. source: re-trace+subagent+log-verified.

name: hca_active_during_action

name: hca_engage_backstop_timer

On expiry sets 0xfffeb66e -> assist_engaged_flags bit0x10 -> hca_max_engage_guard disengage. In continuous HCA the 6-min counter trips first and the down-walk (FUN_0000df86) resets this, so it rarely reaches 0. source: re-trace(verified).

name: rtos_task_dispatcher

PROVEN by Ghidra p-code emulation. This is how the engage-statechart state functions are reached -- they have NO static caller because the pointer is built in RAM at init. name: hca_rx_superv_struct
comment: HCA_01 reception E2E-supervision struct (arg to the fns below). Fields: +0xc=startup state(0=counting,2=done); +0x2c=startup confirm counter (->0x259=601); +0x10/+0x14/+0x18/+0x1c=4 channel states(2=no-data,1/3/4/5/6=recv/pending); +0x21..+0x24=per-channel E2E input codes (3/5/7/9=fresh-valid); +0x28=aggregate output state read by hca_superv_state_to_freshflag; +0x2e/+0x30/+0x32/+0x34=per-channel timeout counters(0x259); +0x36=one-shot missing-msg LATCH. source: re-trace(verified).

name: hca_rx_e2e_statemachine
comment: HCA_01 reception E2E state machine (struct hca_rx_superv_struct). Each channel: 2->1 when its input code says fresh-valid (recovery); a channel timeout counter(0x259) or the startup window closing with all channels still==2 sets the +0x36 latch (0001d2f2.c:19,44). Writes aggregate state +0x28. During startup (+0x2c<601, +0xc==0) output forced to state 1 => EPS reports READY. source: re-trace(verified).

name: hca_fault_bit_recompute
comment: LIVE recompute of the HCA fault bit: _sigblock_status_a |= 0x100 (FAULT) iff (hca_fresh_flag_a&1)==0 OR (hca_fresh_flag_b&1)==0, else clears. Bit 0x100 -> uRamfffee394 -> uRamfffee29c -> assist_mode=2 (LH_EPS_03 FAULT). The RECOVERABLE path. NOTE (adversarial-verified): bit 0x100 is NOT single-sourced -- hca_fault_aggregate_gate (FUN_0001d972, dispatched AFTER this for idx 0xa2/a3/a6) can force it via |=0xc1f9 when the aggregate flags fffea1a0/1ac/19c are stale, SKIPPING this recompute. Recovery needs those aggregates fresh too. source: re-trace(verified).

name: hca_fault_aggregate_gate
comment: Second writer of _sigblock_status_a bit 0x100. The aggregates fffea1a0/fffea1ac/fffea19c are the freshness flags of supervision idx 0xa2/a3/a6 = the REDUNDANT HCA sub-channels (C/D) of the SAME hca_rx_superv_struct (d5ec/d2f2 states 4/5); c992 passes 0xfffed66c for them. So this is the HCA fault aggregated across all 4 redundant channels, NOT a foreign fault: if any is stale -> _sigblock_status_a |= 0xc1f9 (force FAULT + skip hca_fault_bit_recompute). => recovery to READY needs ALL 4 redundant HCA channels fresh, not just the 2 primary flags. source: re-trace(verified).

name: superv_timestamp_countdown
comment: Per-message supervision timestamp/age countdown on superv_msg_flags/timestamp (0xfffe9f14/9f16, stride). Message-present branch decrements the timestamp; at 0 it transitions the state nibble (writes 2 or 8 = bit0 clear = the runtime 'clear' of the freeze-LSB). BUT this recovery branch requires timestamp != 0; superv_freeze_msg zeroes it, so a FROZEN entry's recovery is inert -> latch stays until power cycle. source: re-trace(adversarial-verified).

name: hca_superv_state_to_freshflag
comment: Maps aggregate supervision state (+0x28) to the freshness flag (*param_3 -> hca_fresh_flag_a/b). Sets flag=1 (OK) in states 1/3+cond/4/5. GATED at entry by superv_msg_flags bit0 (frozen/disable): if set, the whole update is SKIPPED -> flag stays 0 -> HCA fault never clears = HARD LATCH. source: re-trace(verified).

name: hca_missing_msg_dtc_commit
comment: Cyclic (via 000275d8): if the +0x36 latch is set AND HCA still not-received on all channels, loops messages and commits CONFIRMED DTCs via dtc_event_set(msg,1,1), then clears +0x36. This is the step that turns a soft missing-HCA fault into a latched one. source: re-trace(verified).

name: dtc_event_set
comment: DTC/event manager: sets event-status + confirmed bit (0x80) in the per-event table (base ~-0x13790); (param2,param3) select set/confirm/query. The confirmed-DTC sink for missing HCA. source: re-trace(verified).

name: superv_freeze_msg
comment: Freezes one message's supervision: superv_msg_flags[msg] = 0x81 (bit0=disable + bit7=confirmed), clears its timestamp. Once set, hca_superv_state_to_freshflag skips that msg -> permanent fault. The HARD-LATCH enforcement. source: re-trace(verified).

name: superv_boot_grace_gate
comment: Boot-grace gate: compares boot_tick_counter vs two thresholds (0x1dbc=7612 ~761ms, 0x22b1=8881 ~888ms); around them (re)initializes the per-msg supervision entries (superv_freeze_msg + superv_set_active_bit) so supervision is suppressed at boot (EPS READY) then activated. source: re-trace(verified).

name: superv_set_active_bit
comment: Sets(0x20)/clears superv_msg_flags bit5 (supervision-active) for one msg based on param2. source: re-trace(verified).

name: superv_dtc_process_cycle
comment: Per-cycle DTC propagation: for each msg walks superv_msg_flags low nibble; uses hca_superv_state_to_freshflag to decide received-ok (set bit2) vs fault (dtc_event_set); clears/consumes the confirmed bit 0x80. source: re-trace(verified).

name: superv_set_e2e_code
comment: Writes a channel's E2E input code into hca_rx_superv_struct+0x20+channel (drives the state machine 2->1 recovery). Called from the HCA RX handler FUN_00026984 with codes derived from the E2E/freshness check. source: re-trace(verified).

name: superv_freeze_on_dtc_op
comment: Freezes all superv_msg_flags entries for a message when a DTC-manager query (dtc_event_set(msg,0xff,5)) returns 0 (e.g. DTC clear/init). source: re-trace(verified).

name: hca_fresh_flag_a
comment: HCA freshness flag ch A (bit0). Set=1 by hca_superv_state_to_freshflag when supervision reports OK; read by hca_fault_bit_recompute. Frozen at 0 if superv_msg_flags disable bit is set. source: re-trace(verified).

name: hca_fresh_flag_b
comment: HCA freshness flag ch B (bit0); the second input to hca_fault_bit_recompute. source: re-trace(verified).

name: superv_msg_flags
comment: Per-message supervision flag table (byte, stride 4, ~0xac msgs; code refs it as addr-0x160ec). bit0=frozen/disable (skips freshness update=hard latch), bit1=pending, bit2=received-ok, bit5=active, bit7=confirmed-DTC. Written by superv_freeze_msg/superv_set_active_bit/superv_dtc_process_cycle. source: re-trace(verified).

name: superv_pending_count
comment: Count of messages with a pending (not-yet-confirmed) supervision fault; decremented as each confirms/clears. source: re-trace(verified).

name: hw_assist_status_sfr
comment: READ-ONLY hardware status register from an external safing/motor-driver monitor chip (peripheral block fffff400=status, fffff402-40a=writable config/control). NEVER written by software -> NOT spoofable via CAN/SW. Low bits 1,2 (&6) = fault/OK pair (FUN_000234a4/2345e). Bit4 (read_assist_active_bit FUN_0002919e, also checked in engage-FSM 0002b45e) = power-stage/motor 'active' discrete; debounced (FUN_00015326 ~300) -> eps_status_flags2 bit0x40 -> HCA supervision ch2 freshness. Polarity (data-confirmed): motor active -> ch2 fresh -> HCA fault recovers; parked/still -> ch2 stale -> latch. ONLY trigger to recover a parked latch = physical steering torque (turn wheel -> base assist -> motor current -> bit4). source: re-trace(verified; MEDIUM on exact bit4 vs bench).

name: read_assist_active_bit
comment: Returns (DAT_fffff400 & 0x1f)>>4 = hw_assist_status_sfr bit4 (assist/safing active). Feeds the HCA ch2 recovery gate. source: re-trace(verified).

name: eps_status_flags2
comment: EPS status flags word 2. Bit0x40 = debounced read_assist_active_bit (set in 000275d8:79 via FUN_00015326). Consumed at 00026984:453: (bit0x40==0) -> HCA supervision ch2 code=5 (fresh) -> aggregate state 3 -> heals BOTH redundant HCA channels -> clears the fault. Also the master 'assist active' gate DAT_fffe9e93. source: re-trace(verified).
